plan.name: Check recordings with bounded disk storage
plan.summary: Add conformance.CheckReader with Check's arguments except an io.Reader in place of raw bytes, and make Check a compatibility wrapper, parsing incrementally into compact invocation-private temporary storage that keeps each distinct canonical state's text once on disk and derives readable diagnostics on demand, with memory limited to small fixed-size state, transition and attempt entries and original-ID mappings, active batches and bounded working storage. Preserve exact canonical equality even when hashing, first-seen identities, JSON validation precedence and messages, Result and Tried semantics, strict declared outcomes, sorted transitions and original attempt order while keeping all variable-size recording contents on disk outside active windows, including tried-action sets; lazily generate and schedule Init windows of at most 1,000 states, ordinary 2,000-step and strict-attempt windows and 1,000-state tried windows with bounded concurrency, isolated copied model modules and deterministic earliest-failure diagnostics, retaining no closure, cancellation function or decoded batch per future batch. Treat input, storage and cancellation failures as operational errors without successful or partial conformance evidence, stop decoding, iteration and scheduling on cancellation, join started checks and close and remove private storage on every exit, preserve caller files and independent invocation stores, and adapt the Python application's ordered runner and its existing number/batch tests to bounded Init batches and deterministic failure prefixes without changing TLC's existing budget or retry policy. Replace representation-dependent decoder assertions in the named existing conformance tests with equivalent store/checker assertions, preserve all other pinned behavior, and run the affected Go suites plus shuffled repeated scheduling and race regressions; unavailable Docker/network integration checks are Merger work, while affected real Python and TLAPS opt-in suites run in PR CI. Update SPEC.md and docs/gate.md to describe the new checker API, memory and temporary-disk costs and cleanup, explicitly leave producer streaming integration to part 2 of #549 and clarify that an individual state, attempt or model need not fit a fixed byte ceiling, citing this ratified plan and recorded foundations D-0029, D-0047, D-0082, D-0085, D-0088, D-0090, D-0105, D-0122, D-0294, D-0306, D-0315 and D-0322 on the relevant SPEC bullets; the merger records the new bounded-storage decision, and this plumbing build does not edit decisions/.

tests.name: TestStreamingConformanceCompatibility
tests.says: Short-read streams and the byte wrapper preserve exact counts, canonical values, legacy stuttering, semantic failures and strict named-action checks.

tests.name: TestStreamingConformanceMalformedInput
tests.says: Field order, repeated fields, null versus empty attempts and malformed recordings preserve JSON semantics, exact refusal messages and validation precedence before TLC.

tests.name: TestStreamingConformanceEarliestFailure
tests.says: Later failing batches can finish first without replacing the earliest step, strict-attempt or untried diagnostic or earning strict-failure coverage.

tests.name: TestStreamingConformanceResources
tests.says: Read/storage errors and cancellation yield operational failures, join checks, remove private stores and preserve caller files across independent invocations.

tests.name: TestStreamingTracePeakHeap
tests.says: File-backed sampled traces with many large distinct states and starts, and twice as many, complete every obligation below the same fixed peak-heap ceiling.

tests.name: TestStreamingAttemptStatePeakHeap
tests.says: File-backed declared attempts over large distinct states keep decoding, Init, Next, strict and tried phases below the same peak-heap ceiling when states double.

tests.name: TestStreamingAttemptContentsPeakHeap
tests.says: Many distinct large attempt arguments over one state, doubled, stay below the same peak-heap ceiling including per-state tried sets while checking every outcome.

tests.name: TestStreamingInitApplicationOrder
tests.says: The byte-input Python ordered-runner adapter handles bounded starting-state batches and retains a stable actual invocation prefix on failure.
